title: 第23章 我挑剩下的第24章 答谢
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 秦关笑了笑然后拿出一颗丹药出来：“来，岳父把这丹药吃了，吃完你就有力气了。”
当看到秦关手里的丹药后，南家人顿时瞪大了眼睛，疗伤神药二品归元丹！
二品丹药，鹿云城天宝阁每个月只限量发售五颗，一颗都要几十万金，秦关这是发大财了啊，随手就拿出一颗二品丹药出来。
南云起看到嘴边的二品归元丹后直接咬牙闭上了嘴巴，拼命的摇头！
让他一口吃下几十万金的丹药治伤，他自己都觉得是暴殄天物，不配吃这么贵的丹药，还不如忍忍把这丹药换成钱来发展南家了！
“父亲，您怎么不吃，快吃啊！”南柔着急道。
“大小姐，家主他这是不舍得吃，一颗归元丹最起码卖三十万金币，家主一定是觉得太奢侈了。”这时，一旁的甲全开口说道。
听到甲全的话，众人皆是心疼的看向南云起，尤其是南家十几个弟子，跟着这样的家主是对的。
“呜喔！”
就在这时，秦关突然捏着南云起的腮帮子使他的嘴张了开来：“钱要紧还是命要紧，给我吃！”
秦关说完一把将归元丹扔进了南云起的嘴巴里。
咕噜！
丹药入口，顺着南云起的喉咙缓缓流进腹中，一股精热的能量瞬间涌向四肢百骸。
不到一盏茶的功夫，南云起的气色明显好了不少，他看向众人无比懊恼道：
“老夫真是没用，到手的一本黄阶高级刀法没保住！”
“爹，我的一本黄阶暗系中级的功法被宋家人抢了！”这时，一旁的南乔也忍不住气恼道。
“什么，暗系中级的功法，咳咳…”
南云起听到一本暗系功法被抢后差点一口气没上来。
“家主属下无能，之前在秘境中那么多宝贝一样都没抢到。”
甲全低下头自责道，闻言另外十多人也都垂下了头，显然他们也是毛都没捞到，还被人打得不轻，关键是南家没有一个盟友…
“姑爷！”
南云起急忙看向秦关一把拉住他的手：“快把那些东西抢回来！”
闻言，众人全都看向秦关，尤其是南乔，此刻她真希望秦关能把她那本暗系功法给抢回来。
秦关摸了摸鼻子轻笑道：“算了吧，那些东西都是我不要的。”
“什么！”
听到秦关的话，躺在地上的南云起整个人直接弹射了起来。
“秦关你刚才的话到底是什么意思？”南云起盯着秦关问道。
“我是说那些东西都是我挑剩下的，原本就没想要，现在再去抢，没意义。”
听到秦关的话，南家人瞬间倒吸一口凉气，那么多被人拼抢厮杀的极品宝物是秦关不要的？
真是败家啊！
“我的姑爷啊，那么多宝贝你为何不要…你…唉？挑剩下的？”
南云起正说着，他突然意识到了什么，挑剩下的，也就是说更好的都被秦关拿走了？
秦关轻轻点头。
见状，南云急忙看向众人：“都回家，咱不争了。”
就在这时，陈贯翔突然带着多名云岚宗的弟子走了过来，他满脸堆笑道：
content_en:
Qin Guan smiled and then took out an elixir: "Come on, father-in-law, take this elixir. After eating it, you will have strength."
When they saw the elixir in Qin Guan's hand, the Nan family's eyes widened immediately. The second-grade healing medicine Guiyuan Dan!
Tianbao Pavilion in Luyun City only sells five second-grade elixirs every month, and one pill costs hundreds of thousands of gold. Qin Guan has made a fortune, so he casually took out a second-grade elixir.
When Nan Yunqi saw the second-grade Guiyuan Pill beside his mouth, he gritted his teeth and closed his mouth, shaking his head desperately!
Asking him to take hundreds of thousands of gold elixirs to treat his injuries in one go, he felt that it was a waste of money. He was not worthy of taking such expensive elixirs. He might as well endure it and exchange the elixirs for money to develop the Nan family!
"Father, why don't you eat? Eat quickly!" Nan Rou said anxiously.
"Miss, the head of the family is reluctant to eat it. A Guiyuan Pill sells for at least 300,000 gold coins. The head of the family must think it is too luxurious." At this time, Jia Quan on the side said.
After hearing Jia Quan's words, everyone looked at Nan Yunqi with distress, especially the dozen or so disciples of the Nan family. It was right to follow such a family leader.
"Oooh!"
At this moment, Qin Guan suddenly pinched Nan Yunqi's cheek and opened his mouth: "What matters is money or life, give it to me!"
After Qin Guan finished speaking, he threw the Guiyuan Pill into Nan Yunqi's mouth.
Gulu!
The elixir entered the mouth and slowly flowed down Nan Yunqi's throat into his abdomen, and a hot energy surged to his limbs and bones in an instant.
In less than a cup of tea, Nan Yunqi's complexion improved significantly. He looked at everyone and said with great annoyance:
"I'm really useless. I can't keep the yellow-level advanced sword technique I got!"
"Dad, my copy of the intermediate yellow-level dark system skills was robbed by the Song family!" At this time, Nan Qiao couldn't help but said angrily.
"What, an intermediate dark-type skill, cough..."
Nan Yunqi almost lost his breath when he heard that a copy of the dark system skills had been robbed.
"The master's subordinates are incompetent. They didn't get any of the treasures in the secret realm before."
Jia Quan lowered his head and blamed himself. Hearing this, more than a dozen other people also lowered their heads. Obviously, they had not caught anything, and they were beaten badly. The key is that the Nan family does not have an ally...
"Uncle!"
Nan Yunqi hurriedly looked at Qinguan and grabbed his hand: "Get those things back quickly!"
Hearing this, everyone looked at Qinguan, especially Nan Qiao. At this moment, she really hoped that Qinguan could snatch her dark-type skills back.
Qin Guan touched his nose and chuckled: "Forget it, I don't want those things."
"What!"
After hearing Qin Guan's words, Nan Yunqi, who was lying on the ground, ejected directly.
"Qing Guan, what do you mean by what you just said?" Nan Yunqi asked, staring at Qing Guan.
"I mean those things were left over from my selection. I didn't want them in the first place. There's no point in grabbing them now."
Hearing Qin Guan's words, the Nan family suddenly took a breath of cold air. Qin Guan didn't want so many top-quality treasures that were being fought for and killed?
What a waste!
"My uncle, there are so many treasures, why don't you... you... sigh? Pick the rest?"
As Nan Yunqi was talking, he suddenly realized something. The rest, that is to say, the better ones were all taken away by Qin Guan?
Qin Guan nodded lightly.
Seeing this, Nan Yun quickly looked at everyone: "Everyone go home, we won't fight anymore."
